config.NOTE: TEMPLATE (harness). Filled when PREREGISTRATION.md is locked; final_score.py refuses until locked=true and the sha256 matches. Arm names = files in runs/final/predictions/. 'mean:a+b' = per-route mean of the two sandbox repeats of one Opus system (each repeat is also reported, with their spread). FINAL model = v1_exact iff results/exact_solver_gate.json verdict is ADOPT, else v1 (and the OPUS-MODEL arm then uses the same solver: opus_model_*_exact or *_greedy). Win for a = mean diff < 0 AND bootstrap CI upper < 0 AND (secondary only) Holm-adjusted sign-test p < 0.05. Every comparison is also reported excluding DBO6. OPTION B (chosen 2026-11-11 ~23:55 IST): each Opus system is scored on its repeat 1 over all routes; repeat 2 runs on the 500 sample only and is used for the solver-noise spread. FIXES 2026-11-12 ~02:00 IST (before the lock, runs/final/incidents.log): (1) a win needs BOTH views (all routes AND excluding DBO6), each with its own Holm; (2) non-inferiority is computed by final_score.py from 'non_inferiority'; (3) OPUS-MODEL default effort is collected as opus_model_default_* (optional, descriptive) so it can no longer overwrite the max-effort primary arm. PRE-LOCK REVIEW (2026-11-12 ~11:50 IST, before the lock): added samesolver_run2..6 (PREREGISTRATION section 6.3, built by scripts/final_samesolver.py from inputs only) and their reference comparisons; descriptive, no claim.
